result.title: MotionShift: Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer via Planner-Evaluator Synergistic Adaptation
result.summary: Existing motion transfer methods excel at exact, rigid motion replication from reference videos to target scenes, whereas they often fail to account for the compatibility between the transferred motion and the target scene environment in accordance with physical laws. In this work, we propose MotionShift, a novel motion transfer framework that achieves high-fidelity motion transfer while ensuring physical compatibility with the target scene. In particular, we design a planner--evaluator iterative motion adaptation mechanism, in which a Large Language Model (LLM) acts as the planner to generate motion trajectories by leveraging its strong semantic reasoning capabilities, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the evaluator to rectify the motion based on its superior visual perception and scene understanding. Through this planner--evaluator synergistic reasoning process, the motion is adapted to the target scene in a training-free manner. The adapted motion is then used as a generative condition for an image-to-video (I2V) model to render videos in the target scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionShift achieves high-fidelity and physically compatible motion transfer across diverse and complex scenes. Moreover, we show that MotionShift can be readily integrated into existing trajectory-conditioned I2V models, endowing them with realistic motion transfer capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MotionShift，用 LLM 作为 planner 生成运动轨迹、VLM 作为 evaluator 依据场景视觉理解迭代修正，从而在无训练条件下把参考运动迁移到目标场景，并作为条件驱动 I2V 模型渲染。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属视频生成与运动迁移，但「planner 生成候选—VLM 视觉评估—迭代修正」的训练无关循环，可供核查其是否对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、验证与停止决策等状态更新机制。
